x-k-k5-01.title: Kungani uJisu ephuzile?
x-k-k5-01.goal: Khetha incazelo efanelana nazo zonke izinkomba engxoxweni emfushane ngesehlakalo esedlule, bese usho ukuthi iyiphi inkomba ethwala isisindo esikhulu nokuthi yini esangabazekile.
x-k-k5-01.material:
Ingxoxo yeqembu lokufunda (스터디 단체 대화방) ngosuku olulandela umhlangano. UJisu wafika sekwephuzile futhi akekho owambuza ngqo ukuthi kungani.
민호: 어제 스터디에 지수 씨가 40분 늦게 왔어요.
하나: 맞아요. 처음에는 전화를 해도 안 받았어요.
민호: 도착했을 때 신발이 다 젖어 있었어요.
지수: 휴대폰이 꺼져서 연락을 못 했어요. 정말 죄송해요.
x-k-k5-01.thinking.1: Ukuhlola incazelo ngayinye ngazo zonke izinkomba
x-k-k5-01.prereq.0: Ufunda imilayezo emifushane yengxoxo ngesikhathi esedlule (-았/었어요)
x-k-k5-01.prereq.1: Uyazi i--아서/어서 nokuxolisa okunenhlonipho kwe--요 okufana ne-죄송해요
x-k-k5-01.s.s1.prompt: Iyiphi incazelo yokuphuza kukaJisu efanelana nazo ZONKE izinkomba ezine (kuphuze, ayiphenduli ucingo, izicathulo ezimanzi, ifoni icishiwe)?
x-k-k5-01.s.s1.hint.0: Landisa izinkomba ezine, bese uhlola incazelo ngayinye ngazo zonke, hhayi eyokuqala kuphela.
x-k-k5-01.s.s1.hint.1: Qhathanisa ukuthi izinkomba ezine incazelo ngayinye ihlanganisa ezingaki, bese uphawula ukuthi yiziphi ezishiywe zingachazwanga.
x-k-k5-01.s.s1.o.a: Walala ngokweqile, bese ephuthuma eya ekhefi ngaphandle kokuhlola ifoni yakhe.
x-k-k5-01.s.s1.r.a: Lokhu kuchaza ukuphuza, kodwa akukho lutho kukho oluchaza izicathulo ezimanzi. Hlola incazelo ngayinye ngokumelene nazo zonke izinkomba.
x-k-k5-01.s.s1.o.b: Wabanjwa yimvula endleleni, futhi ucingo lwakhe lwaphela lapho.
x-k-k5-01.s.s1.r.b: Lokhu kuchaza ukubambezeleka, izicathulo ezimanzi nezingcingo ezingaphendulwanga ndawonye. Ingxoxo ayiboniseli imvula, kodwa yindaba ongashiyi nenkomba engachazwanga.
x-k-k5-01.s.s1.o.c: Wakhohlwa umhlangano waze wafonelwa ngumngane obuza ukuthi uphi.
x-k-k5-01.s.s1.r.c: Uma ucingo lwakhe belucishiwe, akekho obengamfinyelela ngocingo, futhi uxolisa ngokuphuza, hhayi ngokukhohlwa.
x-k-k5-01.s.s1.o.d: Wayengafuni ukuza, ngakho wafika ephuzile ngamabomu futhi wanganaki izingcingo.
x-k-k5-01.s.s1.r.d: Umbhalo ukhombisa ukuxolisa (정말 죄송해요) nenkinga ewusizo (ucingo lucishiwe). Akukho lutho olukhomba ukuthi ufuna ukugwema umhlangano.
x-k-k5-01.s.s1.explain: Izicathulo ezimanzi kanye nocingo olucishiwe kukhomba umcimbi owodwa endleleni (isimo sezulu noma ingozi) ochaza izinkomba eziningana ngesikhathi esisodwa. Imvula iyimbangela engenzeka kakhulu kodwa ayiboniswanga: isihlabathi esimanzi noma isiphuzo esichithekile nakho kungafanela.
x-k-k5-01.s.s2.prompt: NgesiNgisi, qamba izinkomba EZIMBILI ezisekela ukukhetha kwakho kakhulu, ucashunwe isiKorea sasinye, sho ukuthi kungani ngasinye sisekela, futhi uqambe enye into engenzeka.
x-k-k5-01.s.s2.hint.1: Zibuze: yini enye engenza izicathulo zimanzi noma ucingo lucishwe?
x-k-k5-01.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Izinkomba zami ezimbili zivela engxoxweni ngokwayo, hhayi emcabangweni wami?
x-k-k5-01.s.s2.selfAssess.1: 'Okunye okungenzeka' kuhluke ngempela embonweni wami oyinhloko?
x-k-k5-01.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ngisho ukuthi kungani inkomba ibalulekile, hhayi nje ukuyikopisha?
x-k-k5-01.s.s2.model.0: '신발이 다 젖어 있었어요' kukhombisa ukuthi wayengaphandle isimo sezulu esimanzi, futhi '휴대폰이 꺼져서' kuchaza ukuthi kungani engakwazanga ukuphendula izingcingo. Ndawonye zikhomba imvula nocingo olufile, kodwa angase futhi awele kusihlabathi esimanzi, ngakho akuqinisekile.
x-k-k5-01.s.s2.model.1: Izinkomba ezimbili: '전화를 해도 안 받았어요' no-'신발이 다 젖어 있었어요'. Zikhomba ukuthi wayendleleni ngaphandle kocingo olusebenzayo. Mhlawumbe ibhethri locingo lashelela, noma ucingo lwamanzi; angiqiniseki ukuthi yikuphi.
x-k-k5-01.s.s2.modelNote.1: Ipheya yenkomba ehlukile nenye indlela ehlukile; kokubili kuvumelekile.
x-k-k5-01.s.s2.model.2: Izicathulo ezimanzi (신발이 다 젖어 있었어요) nocingo olucishiwe (휴대폰이 꺼져서) kufanelana nendaba yokufakwa amanzi endleleni. Angase awele kusihlabathi esimanzi esikhundleni sokubanjwa yimvula.
x-k-k5-01.s.s2.model.3: Izinkomba eziqinile kakhulu: '신발이 다 젖어 있었어요' kusitshela ukuthi wayengaphandle isimo sezulu esimanzi, futhi '휴대폰이 꺼져서' kuchaza izingcingo ezingaphendulwanga. Okunye okungenzeka: waweleka kusihlabathi esimanzi futhi ucingo lwamanzi.

x-k-k5-06.title: Ukukhansela isikhathi sokuhlangana nosolwazi
x-k-k5-06.goal: Nquma ukuthi yini eshodayo emlayezweni wokukhansela obhalelwe umngani, bese uwubhala kabusha ukuze usolwazi.
x-k-k5-06.material:
Ubunesikhathi sehhovisi nosolwazi wakho kusasa ngo-3:00. Ithebula lekilasi lakho selishintshile futhi awukwazi ukuya. Umdwebo wakho wokuqala:
"교수님, 내일 3시에 못 가요. 다른 일이 있어요. 다음에 갈게요."
x-k-k5-06.s.s1.prompt: Yiziphi izinkinga ezinalo lo mdwebo kuSOLWAZI ofunda wona?
x-k-k5-06.s.s1.hint.0: Cabanga ukuthi unguprofesa: ungadinga ukwazi ini ngemva kokuwufunda?
x-k-k5-06.s.s1.hint.1: Hlola inketho ngayinye ngamagama angempela omdwebo.
x-k-k5-06.s.s1.o.a: Awusho ukuthi ubani obhalayo noma yiliphi ikilasi
x-k-k5-06.s.s1.r.a: Usolwazi ethola imilayezo eminingi futhi udinga ukwazi othumelayo nesifundo.
x-k-k5-06.s.s1.r.b: Isikhathi negama 내일 kukhombisa isikhathi esihlosiwe; lolo ngxenye yomdwebo isebenza.
x-k-k5-06.s.s1.r.c: '다음에' ayicacile kakhulu ukuthi usolwazi ahlele ngayo.
x-k-k5-06.s.s1.o.d: Isebenzisa isikhathi esedlule entweni yesikhathi esizayo
x-k-k5-06.s.s1.r.d: Umdwebo usebenzisa izimo zesikhathi samanje/esizayo (못 가요, 갈게요), hhayi esedlule.
x-k-k5-06.s.s1.explain: Umdwebo uqamba isikhathi sokuhlangana kodwa hhayi obhalayo, awuxolisi nanoma kuphi futhi ushiya isinyathelo esilandelayo sivulekile. Isikhathi esedlule sihle futhi isikhathi sicacile.
x-k-k5-06.s.s1.acc.0: Umfundi angase azizwe ukuthi ukuxolisa kungumqondo wethoni kunokuqukethwe; othumelayo nesikhathi esisha kusakhona izikhala eziyinhloko.
x-k-k5-06.s.s2.prompt: Bhala kabusha umlayezo kusolwazi ngesiKorea: zethule nekilasi lakho, uxolise, unikeze isizathu esifushane, bese uphakamisa isikhathi esisha. Sebenzisa iziphetho ezisemthethweni, ezihloniphekile.
x-k-k5-06.s.s2.hint.0: Hlela izingxenye ezine: ngubani mina, ngiyaxolisa, isizathu, isikhathi esisha.
x-k-k5-06.s.s2.hint.1: Khetha iziphetho ze--ㅂ니다 noma -세요 kuyo yonke indawo.

x-k-k5-08.title: Ubani obesemtatsheni wezincwadi?
x-k-k5-08.goal: Linganisa izindaba ezintathu ntambama efanayo bese usho lokho okungaphethwa nokungaphethwa, bese uqamba indlela yokuthola okwengeziwe.
x-k-k5-08.material:
Ikilasi liphela ngo-3:30. Ikhaya lika-Minsu lingu-30 imizuzu ukuhamba ngezinyawo ukusuka esikoleni, futhi uhlala ehamba ngezinyawo (akukho ibhasi). Abafundi abathathu bakhuluma ngosuku olulandelayo.
민수: 어제 수업이 끝나고 바로 집에 갔어요.
하나: 어제 4시쯤 도서관에서 민수 씨를 봤어요. 책을 빌리고 있었어요.
준호: 저는 4시 30분쯤 도서관에 있었는데 민수 씨는 못 봤어요.
x-k-k5-08.thinking.1: Ukuhlukanisa lokho okufakazelwe nalokho okuhambisana nje
x-k-k5-08.s.s1.hint.0: Bala ukuthi u-Minsu ubezofika ekhaya nini uma ehamba ngokushesha.
x-k-k5-08.s.s1.hint.1: Qhathanisa isikhathi sendaba ngayinye nezinye: ipheya lingabamba umzuzu ofanayo?
x-k-k5-08.s.s1.o.a: Indaba ka-Hana neka-Minsu iyaphikisana, futhi eka-Junho ayinquli phakathi kwazo
x-k-k5-08.s.s1.r.a: U-Minsu ubengeke abe ekhaya ngaphambi kuka-4:00 uma ehamba eqonde ekhaya, ngakho akakwazi nokuba emtatsheni wezincwadi ngo-4:00; isikhathi sika-Junho sihlukile.
x-k-k5-08.s.s1.o.b: U-Minsu uyakhohlisa ngokuya ngqo ekhaya, ngoba u-Hana wamubona emtatsheni wezincwadi
x-k-k5-08.s.s1.r.b: Indaba eyodwa iphikisana neyenye, kodwa ukungavumelani akubonisi ukuthi ubani oyiphutha noma ukuthi ukhona okhohlisile.
x-k-k5-08.s.s1.o.c: U-Hana kumele abe yiphutha, ngoba u-Junho wayesemtatsheni wezincwadi kamuva futhi akamboni u-Minsu
x-k-k5-08.s.s1.r.c: U-Junho ufike ihora eliyingxenye kamuva kunesikhathi sika-Hana, ngakho indaba yakhe ayisho lutho ngo-4:00.
x-k-k5-08.s.s1.o.d: Zonke izindaba ezintathu zingaba yiqiniso ngasikhathi sinye, ngoba akekho unikeza isikhathi sewashi
x-k-k5-08.s.s1.r.d: Ukuba ekhaya ngo-4:00 nokuboleka incwadi emtatsheni wezincwadi ngo-4:00 akunakuba yiqiniso kokubili kumuntu oyedwa.
x-k-k5-08.s.s1.explain: Ukuhamba eqonde ekhaya kuthatha kuze kube ngu-4:00 cishe, ngakho u-Minsu akakwazi ukuba emtatsheni wezincwadi ngo-4:00. Noma u-Minsu noma u-Hana uyiphutha (noma '4 shortly after' isho ngokungaqondile). U-Junho ufike ngo-4:30, ngakho akabonisi lutho ngo-4:00.
x-k-k5-08.s.s2.prompt: NgesiNgisi, qamba into eyodwa ongayibuza noma uyihlole ukuthola ukuthi ubani olungile, ucashise amagama esiKorea akwenza usole.
x-k-k5-08.s.s2.hint.0: Khetha izikhathi ezimbili ezingqubuzanayo bese ubuza ukuthi yini engazihlukanisa.
x-k-k5-08.s.s2.hint.1: Ukuhlola okuhle yinto umuntu angayenza ngempela.
x-k-k5-08.s.s2.model.0: Buza u-Hana ukuthi uqiniseke kangakanani nge-'4시쯤' nokuthi ukhulumile naye yini, futhi ubuze u-Minsu ukuthi ufike ekhaya ngasiphi isikhathi, ngoba '바로 집에 갔어요' kumele kusho ukuthi wayekhaya cishe ngo-4:00.
x-k-k5-08.s.s2.model.1: Hlola irekhodi lokuboleka lomtapo wezincwadi: uma u-Minsu eboleke incwadi cishe ngo-'4시쯤' ngakho u-Hana ulungile; u-'4시 30분쯤' ka-Junho uphuzile ngehora eliyingxenye, ngakho akunquli lutho.
x-k-k5-08.s.s2.model.2: Ngizovakashela umtapo wezincwadi ngibheke amarekhodi okuboleka ukuze ngibone ukuthi u-Minsu eboleke incwadi nini, ngoba u-Hana uthi '4시쯤' kodwa u-Minsu uthi '바로 집에 갔어요'.

x-k-k5-09.title: Vumela umfundi aqagele ukuthi kungani
x-k-k5-09.topic: ukubhala ngesikhathi esedlule ukuze isizathu singaqondwa
x-k-k5-09.goal: Tshela ukuthi yimaphi amatheksthi amafushane ashiya isizathu singashiwo, bese ubhala owakho ukuze umfundi aqagele isizathu ngaphandle kokutshelwa.
x-k-k5-09.material: Imibhalo emine emifushane, ngayinye ichaza okuthile okwenzekile. Kweminye, isizathu sishiwo ngamagama; kweminye, umfundi kumele asiqagele.
x-k-k5-09.prereq.0: Wazi isikhathi esedlule ne--아서/어서/그래서 njengamagama esizathu
x-k-k5-09.s.s1.prompt: Imibhalo EMIBILI iyiphi lapho isizathu SISHIWO ngamagama, kodwa umfundi usaqagela?
x-k-k5-09.s.s1.hint.0: Funda umbhalo ngamunye ubuze 'kungani lokhu kwenzeke?'. Bese uhlola ukuthi umbhalo uphendula lowo mbuzo ngamagama.
x-k-k5-09.s.s1.hint.1: Buza ukuthi, ngaphandle kwamagama esizathu, ungasaqagela okwenzekile.
x-k-k5-09.s.s1.r.a: '몸이 아파서' isho isizathu nge--아서, ngakho akudingeki ukuqagela.
x-k-k5-09.s.s1.r.b: Alikho igama lesizathu, kodwa 병원, 약 ne-누웠어요 ndawonye kuvumela umfundi aqonde ukugula.
x-k-k5-09.s.s1.r.c: Alikho igama lesizathu, kodwa ukungabi nasambulela kanye nezingubo ezimanzi kuvumela umfundi aqonde imvula.
x-k-k5-09.s.s1.explain: Ku-b no-c umfundi kumele axhumanise imininingwane (isibhedlela + umuthi, noma ukungabi nasambulela + izingubo ezimanzi). Ku-a no-d igama lesizathu (-아서, 그래서) lisho ngqo.
x-k-k5-09.s.s2.prompt: Bhala imisho engu-2-3 yesiKorea ngokwenzekile iviki eledlule (okwakho noma okwenziwe) ukuze isizathu sento eyodwa singashiwo kodwa siqageleke. Ungasebenzisi isiphetho sesizathu (-아서/어서/해서, -니까), 그래서, 때문에 noma 이유. (가서/와서 ye-'hamba bese wenza' ilungile.)
x-k-k5-09.s.s2.hint.0: Khetha isizathu kuqala, bese ukhetha imininingwane emibili ekhomba kusona ngaphandle kokusiqamba.
x-k-k5-09.s.s2.modelNote.2: Ukugula kushiywe kumfundi; 가서 ukulandelana, hhayi isizathu.
